By way of present application filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No. 166/2021 registered under Section 420 IPC at P.S. K.N.K. Marg.

On merits, it is submitted that the complainant i.e. M/s Medisure Inc. has filed the present FIR with the allegations that it had placed an order of supply of 35,000 PPE Kits to M/s CBR Hospital, New Delhi of which applicant is proprietor.
